message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Overview** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways, 25 mph on city streets.
• School zones: 20 mph (or 15 mph if posted). | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system). | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02%). | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, vehicles approaching from the right have priority.
• Stop signs require a full stop; yield signs require slowing and yielding. | | **Lane Discipline** | • “Lane discipline” law: drivers must stay in their lane unless turning or passing. | | **Headlights & Signals** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Turn signals must be used at least 100 ft before a turn. | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or intersection.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited unless marked. | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children. | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing is allowed only with a valid permit and following specific regulations. | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Registration must be renewed annually; inspections required for certain vehicles. | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Speed cameras are used in some counties; fines are issued automatically. | ### Where to Find Official Texts - **Texas Transportation Code** – Chapter 545 (Traffic Rules) and Chapter 546 (Traffic Regulations). - **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – provides downloadable PDFs of the Texas Transportation Code. - **Texas Legislature Online** – searchable database of statutes. ### Common Enforcement Practices - **Speeding**: Police use radar guns; automated speed cameras in some counties. - **Seat‑belt & Cell‑phone**: Random checkpoints and traffic stops. - **DUI**: Breathalyzer tests; roadside sobriety tests. ### Recent Updates (2024) - **Electronic Toll Collection**: Expanded use of TxTag on toll roads. - **Smart City Initiatives**: Some municipalities are testing adaptive traffic signal systems. - **COVID‑19 Adjustments**: Temporary changes to parking restrictions in certain areas. --- #### Quick Reference Links - [TxDMV – Traffic Laws](https://www.txdmv.gov/) - [Texas Legislature Online – Transportation Code](https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/) Feel free to let me know if you need deeper details on a specific section or how to locate the official statutes!
